seo.metaDescription: Injured in a car accident in Oroville, CA? LawProactive connects you free with an independent attorney. No fee unless you recover.

hero.subtitle: If a collision on Oroville Dam Boulevard or Olive Highway has left you hurt, LawProactive can connect you with an independent attorney at no cost to you. We're not a law firm — just a free bridge to legal help while you focus on getting better.

about.title: Oroville Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Butte County's public crash records show Oroville logged 102 injury collisions and 145 injured people last year, with Tuesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. showing up often in the data. Corridors like Oroville Dam Boulevard East and West, Olive Highway, and Feather River Boulevard carry heavy local traffic, and that volume shows up in the numbers. If you were hurt in one of these crashes, the days right after matter — insurance adjusters move fast, and evidence like skid marks, dashcam footage, or witness memories can fade. LawProactive doesn't practice law or promise any result. What we do is connect injured Oroville residents with an independent personal injury attorney, free of charge, so you have someone in your corner who understands California's rules before you say anything to an insurance company.
commonInjuries: Torn ligaments and soft tissue damage
about.ctaText: Get connected with an independent attorney today — free, no obligation.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash to file a claim in California, but if a government entity — like Butte County or Caltrans — is involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Missing it can end your case before it starts.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your share of blame reduces your compensation. What you say to an insurance adjuster in a recorded statement can be used to shift more fault onto you.

items.title: No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: Attorneys in LawProactive's network work on contingency, meaning there's no upfront cost and no fee unless money is recovered on your behalf.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's usually best to avoid it until you've spoken with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can minimize your claim or shift fault onto you. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my crash happened near Oroville Dam Boulevard and involved a city or county vehicle?
items.answer: Claims against government entities in California often carry a much shorter deadline, sometimes as little as six months instead of two years. Because Oroville has several city- and county-maintained roads, it's worth having this checked quickly by an attorney.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect me with an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service, and there's no cost to you for the connection itself. Any attorney you're matched with typically works on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation.
